mapper.select: WITH group_devices AS ( SELECT dgr.device_id FROM bbx_device_group_rel dgr JOIN bbx_device_group dg ON dgr.group_id = dg.id WHERE dg.group_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{groupCode},'%') AND dg.deleted = 1 AND dg.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dgr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ), alarm_data AS ( SELECT ai.alarm_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bbx_alarm_info ai JOIN bbx_alarm_device ad ON ai.id = ad.alarm_id WHERE ad.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM group_devices) AND ai.deleted = 1 AND ad.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY ai.alarm_name ) SELECT alarm_name AS name, cnt AS count, ROUND(cnt * 100.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (), 2) AS ratio FROM alarm_data ORDER BY cnt DESC;

WITH group_devices AS ( SELECT dgr.device_id FROM bbx_device_group_rel dgr JOIN bbx_device_group dg ON dgr.group_id = dg.id WHERE dg.group_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{groupCode},'%') AND dg.deleted = 1 AND dg.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dgr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ), alarm_data AS ( SELECT ai.alarm_level, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bbx_alarm_info ai JOIN bbx_alarm_device ad ON ai.id = ad.alarm_id WHERE ad.device_id IN (SELECT device_id FROM group_devices) AND ai.deleted = 1 AND ad.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ai.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY ai.alarm_level ) SELECT alarm_level AS level, cnt AS count, ROUND(cnt * 100.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (), 2) AS ratio FROM alarm_data ORDER BY cnt DESC;
